task: E — ncipidkg protein-interaction context for MS core proteins
verdict: CLEAN NEGATIVE for MS. ncipidkg as published in the OKN federation is a small demonstration subgraph, not the full NCI-PID.

ms_overlap.result: ZERO overlap. None of the 59 MS core proteins appear in ncipidkg, in either direction, by node IRI or by label.

method_notes: ncipidkg protein nodes are http://identifiers.org/uniprot/{acc} — prokn uses http://purl.uniprot.org/uniprot/{acc}. The join therefore REQUIRES an IRI rewrite: BIND(IRI(REPLACE(STR(?p),'http://purl.uniprot.org/uniprot/','http://identifiers.org/uniprot/'))). This explains the previously verified crosswalk count of 12 — the overlap is genuinely tiny because the graph itself is tiny, not because of an id mismatch.
rdfs:label exists on only 16 nodes in the entire graph (the 16 demo proteins), so symbol-based lookup is not viable for arbitrary genes.
Node IRIs use non-canonical/secondary UniProt accessions (e.g. A6NFQ0 for NUP214, A6NL14 for XPO1) with owl:sameAs to alternates; canonical accessions such as P40763 (STAT3) are absent entirely.

Edge metadata IS rich where it exists: every reified statement carries okn:evidenceCount (1-214 INDRA evidences) and okn:evidenceUrl (db.indra.bio), and PTM statements carry okn:processType as a GO term (GO_0016925 sumoylation, GO_0016567 ubiquitination, GO_0016579 deubiquitination, GO_0016926 desumoylation).
Biological content is a SUMOylation / nuclear-pore module: PIAS1, PIAS2, UBE2I, SUMO1, HDAC1, HDAC4, MDM2, XPO1, RANBP2, RANGAP1, RAN, NUP62, NUP153, NUP210, NUP214, plus the viral protein Gam1.
USE-OR-DROP: DROP for MS. It contributes no MS protein, pathway or PTM evidence.
